name: Liberal Arts
overview: Liberal arts represents a vibrant tapestry, weaving together different aspects of creativity and expression that encompasses painting, sculpture, drawing, and digital media. The field explores deep ideas, talks about society, and expresses personal feelings while blending creative ideas with technical expertise. Modern practitioners question the usual ways of doing things and use diverse materials and technologies.
